    @pytest.mark.priority(25)
    @allure.title("Water Target Negative Test Cases")
    @allure.description("Test invalid inputs: negative numbers, zero, non-numeric, special characters, decimals.")
    def test_25_water_target_negative_tests(self):
        """Test negative scenarios for water target input."""
        page = self.set_targets_page
    
        # Get unit configuration
        config = page.get_water_unit_config()
        unit = config["unit"]
        max_value = config["max_value"]
        min_value = config["min_value"]
    
        # Negative Test 1: Zero value (should reset to min)
        page.input_box.fill("0")
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert val == min_value, f"Zero should reset to min ({min_value}), got {val}"
    
        # Negative Test 2: Negative value (should reset to min)
        page.input_box.fill("-10")
